drafts.subject: Re: HLA-24019 – lab dips, payment, samples
drafts.body:
Hi Emily,

Thank you for your email dated 2026‑10‑25.

1. Lab dips – Deep Navy option B is approved. Stone Grey appears too green; we will resubmit a corrected dip for your review.  
2. Payment – we have confirmed receipt of your 30 % advance for PO HLA‑24019 today.  
3. Samples – we will prepare and send two PP samples per colour in size M (Deep Navy, Stone Grey, Navy, White) before bulk cutting begins.  
4. New PO – we have not received a separate new PO; please advise if additional details are required.

Regarding delivery, the current plan for 3 600 pcs by 2026‑12‑18 is not feasible due to capacity constraints. The earliest date we can ship the full quantity is **2027‑02‑25**. If this works for you, please confirm and we will adjust the schedule accordingly.

Best regards,  
Karthik  
Merchandiser  
Sri Velan Knits
